Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING (8)': Agents In The Court, Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Yarna d'al' Gargan, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Uh-oh!, Wise Advice and Do, Or Do Not; these count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'Wise Advice' and 'Do, Or Do Not' on separate lines dested the separate Special Edition Effect Wise Advice and Dagobah Effect Do, Or Do Not (not the Reflections II combo or the Reflections III shields).
Posted 'EPP Luke' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'CZ-3' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three); 'Tatooine Desert' Tatooine: Desert (Jabba's Palace); bare 'Desert' the Special Edition Desert site; 'Uh-Oh' Uh-oh!.

The author's update (Underworld Contacts out for TK-422; H'nemthe out for another Palace Raider) is not applied; dested as posted. A later revision is live as [[Ryan Austin Agents of DEATH v 2 0]] (DeckTech 13144, 23 January 2001); this post is the original list, not a repost.
